name: SDSU SODEXO - HANSEN HALL JACKS C STORE

violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Upright 2 door cooler in old main kitchen area has milk spills and needs cleaning.

Manual cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --An approved sanitizer was not used during three compartment sink operation. Cleaner/disinfectant being used in c-store not for use on food contact surfaces per manufacturer's directions.
Sanitizing solution testing devices. — --Test strip or kit that accurately measures the sanitizing concentration was not provided. Test strips not available for chemical used as sanitizer.
Plumbing system. — --Plumbing system was not designed, constructed, operated and/or maintained according to regulation. Utility sink faucet leaks.

Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. Mop currently stored in mop bucket. Store in a position that allows mop to properly dry between uses.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. Store cleaning chemicals away from single service towels in back storage room.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored, handled, dispensed in a manner to protect from contamination. -Store single serve items next to refuse under Starbucks branded coffee maker.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Chemical spill by mop sink in mechanical room.

Handling and storage of poisonous and toxic materials. — --Poisonous or toxic material was not stored in a manner to protect against contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items. -Chemical spray bottles stored next to single-use cups.
